messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 - Elevated inference latency for Hosted API (us-west-2). Pager triggered by latency+5xx. Incident created id=3307778888. Incident workspace: https://ops.redwood.ai/incident/3307778888

maria (oncall): Ack. I'm taking initial triage. Opening war room -> https://meet.google.com/aaa-bbbb-ccc

maria (oncall): Owner? I'll own until handoff unless someone else wants it.

raj (eng-sre): I can co-own. joining war room now.

paul (infra): Paging confirmed. PagerDuty escalation sent to SRE-signal. Received ack from oncall.

devops-bot: Autoscaler triggered: +2 dedicated GPU nodes started. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/3307778888/autoscale.txt

sasha (product): Heads-up: customers seeing higher error rates on streaming responses. We should update status page and prepare customer comms.

maria (oncall): Agreed. Sasha can you draft a short status update? Keep it short: what, where, impact, we are investigating.

sasha (product): Draft below. React :eyes: if OK to post.

[sasha's draft]
We are investigating elevated latency and intermittent errors for Redwood Hosted API in the us-west-2 region. Our team has opened an incident and is actively investigating. Some API requests may see delayed responses or 5xx errors. We're working to mitigate impact and will provide updates soon.
[end draft]

tom (support): I'll prepare a customer-facing email template for impacted customers (dedicated capacity customers unaffected). cc @sasha for approval.

maria (oncall): Confirmed: Dedicated customers unaffected — add that in the status and email.

raj (eng-sre): Early findings: increased tail latency on attention kernels, looks like degraded GPU utilization followed by retries. Small snippet from nvtop: 

[code]
GPU0: 12% | GPU1: 96% | GPU2: 15% | GPU3: 98%
Processes: model_server(1) pinned to GPU1,GPU3 only
[end code]

paul (infra): That looks like skewed placement after the morning rollout. Starting drain+reschedule on GPU1/GPU3 now.

maria (oncall): Can someone confirm whether we should rollback or try rebalance first?

raj (eng-sre): Trying non-disruptive rebalancing first. If imbalance persists after 5m, plan B = rollback last infra change.

devops-bot: Rebalance job submitted: job_id=rb-3307778-01 status=running

maria (oncall): @paul please confirm PD contact list and escalate to CS/legal if customers request credits.

paul (infra): PD contact list in the incident doc. Legal on standby; pinged cs-leads.

sasha (product): Also propose posting to status.redwood.ai with a short message + "next update in 15m".

maria (oncall): OK. @sasha post when ready, I'll add timeline info.

sasha (product): Posting status page now.

devops-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3307778888 content_id=st-3307

tom (support): Customer email draft: 

[code]
Subject: Temporary service disruption in US-West
Body:
Hi <Customer>,

We're investigating a service degradation impacting some API requests in the US-West region. This may cause delayed responses or intermittent errors. Our team is actively mitigating; dedicated capacity customers are not affected.

Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have more info.

Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Inference Support
[end code]

sasha (product): Approved. Tom can send to impacted customer list after I confirm the list from analytics.

maria (oncall): War room notes: priority=P1, impact=partial outage for Hosted API (us-west-2), mitigation=rebalancing nodes, fallback plan=rollback infra change. Handoff plan: if we move to monitoring, close war room after 30m.

raj (eng-sre): Rebalancing completed. GPU utilization now balanced. Monitoring tail latency.

devops-bot: Rebalance status: success job_id=rb-3307778-01 duration=92s

maria (oncall): Observed ~80% reduction in 95p latency. Still seeing occasional spikes. Holding policy: wait 10m; if stable, declare mitigation and transition to monitoring.

paul (infra): No further deployments in us-west-2 for 1 hour. Deployment lock applied.

lucy (docs): Note for postmortem: include kernel selection and placement bug. I'll start the template.

maria (oncall): @tom queue the customer notices but hold send until Sasha confirms impacted list. Also prepare internal comms summary for execs.

tom (support): Queued draft, will send after sasha OKs list.

sasha (product): I have the list and give greenlight — send now.

tom (support): Sent to 42 customers. Copy posted to incident doc.

maria (oncall): Declaring mitigation at 3307778940 — latency within SLO for 10 minutes. Transitioning to monitoring phase. War room will remain open for 30m then close unless alerts return.

devops-bot: Incident state changed to MITIGATED -> monitoring; timeline updated.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. @raj please take postmortem ownership. @lucy coordinate docs. I'll do the oncall handoff summary.

raj (eng-sre): Accepted postmortem owner. Will coordinate root cause analysis and timeline.

maria (oncall): Handoff: my oncall shift ends. Next oncall is paul; please ack when you take over monitoring.

paul (infra): Ack. Taking over monitoring; will escalate if regression appears.

maria (oncall): Closing notes: status page will be updated with a resolved message once the postmortem is ready. Great work everyone. :sparkles:
